title: BUILDING A HOUSE AT SQUARE ONE
passages: House of Square One gave that exploration a shared shape. Community, craft, collaboration, courage. Beginners learning from people with experience. Artists exploring what it meant to become models.

The Lovers Ball became a place to bring the practice into the room. Clothes, faces, nerves, performance, people helping one another arrive. Something that had sounded like a fantasy was becoming an event we had actually made happen. Starting over could be a creative act we did together.

reflections.prompt: Imagine a small project you could begin with someone else. Who would you invite, and what could each of you bring?
Draft a one-sentence invitation to your shared project. Decide who you would like to ask.
